title: בייתוס בן זונין

paragraphs: Boethus ben Zunin sold his field on Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah’s instruction, Megillah27b; Arakhin31a; Mishnah Bava Metzia, Eizehu Neshekh (65b); Soferim 3 also reports that he acted on Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah’s instruction. Jerusalem Pesachim, Kol Sha'ah, halakhah4: asked Gamliel and sages at Yavneh. Tosefta, end of Pesachim: Gamliel and elders at his house. Yehudah: “Boethus asked the sages,” Pesachim37a. Jerusalem Shabbat8:6, end of Hamotzi Yayin: Rav Yehudah says Boethus ben Zunin sat studying before Rabbi. Zunin appears before Rabbi, Gamliel, and Akiva: thus two Boethuses and two Zunins. Yuchasin’s chronological section apparently makes the Elazar ben Azaryah-era Boethus a priest, listing him among priests.
